Join Pharmacosmos in a newly established role and take a leading scientific role in shaping the analytical development capabilities.

**Lead complex Analytical Development across a growing development pipeline

**As Principal Analytical Development Chemist at Pharmacosmos, you will serve as the Analytical Lead across CMC development programs, driving analytical development, characterization, control strategies, and regulatory readiness from early-stage development through commercialization to lifecycle activities.

In this high impact role, you will be responsible for driving analytical development and ensuring that robust analytical methods, specifications, stability strategies, and control frameworks are established to support successful product development, regulatory submissions, and commercial manufacturing. You will apply your scientific expertise to complex analytical challenges, including product characterization, impurity profiling, method development, method qualification, validation strategy, comparability assessments, and technical investigations, helping to de-risk development programs and accelerate progress.

Working closely with Drug Substance Leads, Drug Product Leads, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, and external development partners, you will provide strategic guidance and scientific leadership across the organization. You will oversee analytical activities performed both internally and through CROs, CDMOs, and specialist laboratories, ensuring high-quality execution, sound scientific decision-making, and timely delivery of project objectives.

Beyond supporting individual projects, you will contribute to strengthening Pharmacosmos' analytical capabilities by advancing laboratory technologies, scientific best practices, and knowledge sharing across teams. As a trusted technical expert, you will mentor colleagues, influence key decisions, and help build a culture of scientific excellence, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration.

**Highly skilled Analytical Development Chemist with strong project management capabilities

**We are seeking a highly qualified candidate with an MSc or PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline. You bring extensive experience from the pharmaceutical industry, typically gained over 10 years or more, and possess a strong track record within analytical development ideally across both drug substance and drug product development. You have in-depth experience with analytical characterization, method development, qualification, and transfer, as well as specification setting, stability programs, impurity characterization, and analytical control strategies. Experience working with CROs, CDMOs, external laboratories, and cross-functional CMC teams is essential, together with a solid understanding of regulatory requirements and CMC documentation. You are an established scientific leader who can independently drive complex analytical activities and influence decision-making through technical expertise and sound scientific judgment.

You are a scientifically driven and highly analytical professional who thrives in a dynamic and collaborative environment. You combine deep technical expertise with a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset and are motivated by solving complex challenges and advancing pharmaceutical development programs. You work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities, and communicate complex scientific topics with clarity and credibility. Through strong collaboration and stakeholder engagement, you create alignment across functions and external partners while maintaining focus on quality, timelines, and business objectives. You are structured, proactive, and resilient, with a strong sense of integrity and accountability, and you enjoy sharing knowledge and contributing to a culture of scientific excellence and continuous improvement. Finally, you are fluent in English, both written and verbal.

**Play a crucial role in an exciting international growth journey

**This is your chance to embark upon a personal and organizational journey in a dynamic company where your know-how is greatly needed for the future development of Pharmacosmos. The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search. For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Sr. Executive Search Consultant, Lars Nordlund, on +45 3123 3018. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV - it is not necessary to include a cover letter.

Pharmacosmos

Pharmacosmos A/S is a global leader in carbohydrate chemistry and innovative treatments for iron deficiency and iron deficiency anaemia. Building on our foundational expertise in carbohydrate chemistry and cell cycle biology, we develop innovative treatments for unmet patient needs, with a focus on iron metabolism and blood-related disorders. Founded in 1965 and headquartered in Denmark, our team is made up of more than 650 specialists across the UK, Ireland, the Nordics, Germany, Canada, and the USA. Learn more about Pharmacosmos at www.pharmacosmos.com.

The Company

COWI is a leading international consultancy within engineering, architecture, energy, and the environment. In close collaboration with clients, COWI co-creates innovative and sustainable solutions that enhance quality of life for current and future generations. With a primary presence in Scandinavia, the United Kingdom, North America, and India, COWI employs approximately 7,500 professionals who bring expertise across a wide range of disciplines.

If you are curious to learn more, we invite you to explore some of COWI’s featured projects at www.cowi.com or view their global portfolio at: Projects around the world (cowi.com)

On behalf of COWI, Best Talent is now seeking an Associate Project Director.

The organisation & the Team

COWI’s Building & Industry Executing Unit in Denmark, consists of approximately 1050 professionals and specialists across building related disciplines.

Within this framework, you will be part of a dedicated Multidisciplinary Project Management team in Lyngby, consisting of approximately 38 committed colleagues. This structure ensures a strong, supportive, and highly professional environment focused on excellence in project delivery.

As part of this strong professional community, you will work alongside dedicated, talented, and ambitious colleagues who are strongly committed to excellence in project leadership and management. Moreover, you will have the opportunity to realize your full potential within an inclusive and supportive professional environment.

Associate Project Director

Exiting Multidisciplinary Building Projects - From Design to Execution

• Strong focus on clients and project delivery

• Thrive in a collaborative and supportive culture

• Shape your own professional development

• Contribute to a more sustainable and livable world

The Challenge

As Associated Project Director for construction projects in Denmark, you will be responsible for the comprehensive management of building projects—from initial planning through to execution. Your role will encompass quality assurance, budget control, contractual and financial oversight, as well as the coordination of timelines and resources.

You will also act as the key liaison with clients and collaborate closely with stakeholders such as public authorities, contractors, and design partners.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading new construction and renovation projects from concept to completion

• Participating in large-scale projects as part of a broader project management team

• Managing complex stakeholder environments, clients, authorities, contractors, and design partners

• Maintain close collaboration with clients to ensure their needs and expectations are consistently met

• Overseeing project scope, schedule, risks, and cost management

• Ensuring high standards of quality, safety, and sustainability across all project stages

• Driving cross-disciplinary collaboration across COWI’s teams and geographies

• Contributing to the professional development of project team members

Why join COWI?

At COWI, your work contributes to shaping a sustainable and liveable world. By combining deep knowledge, curiosity, and courage, COWI develops solutions that address today’s challenges and enable a better tomorrow. COWI has committed to phasing out fossil-based projects and aspires for 100% of its revenue to stem from sustainability-focused initiatives.

COWI values diversity, continuous development, and a sense of belonging. They foster a supportive and enjoyable workplace, knowing that a healthy work-life balance enhances performance both professionally and personally. You will report to the Vice President of the group and be offered a competitive compensation package, aligned with your experience and qualifications.

Your profile & Talent:

You are an experienced Multidisciplinary Project Manager who thrives in collaboration with colleagues, partners, and clients. You foster strong relationships through integrity, accountability, and a proactive mindset. Your background has equipped you to confidently lead medium- to large-scale design projects.

Qualifications and key competencies:

• A relevant academic background in civil engineering, architecture, or a related discipline

• Professional experience in Denmark, with in-depth knowledge of all phases of the Danish building project lifecycle

• Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to manage complex project environments

• A proactive and structured approach to work, with keen attention to detail

• A self-motivated and inspiring personality that promotes teamwork and positive dynamics

• Proficiency in Danish and English, both spoken and written

Diversity and inclusion:

Diversity is a core value at COWI, and inclusion is a strategic priority. The company is committed to fostering a respectful, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities for growth. Leaders at COWI are expected to model inclusive behaviour and embrace diverse perspectives as a strength in team formation and decision-making processes. These commitments are not only embedded in COWI’s values—they are part of what the company believes is the right thing to do.

Application

Best Talent is managing the recruitment process and will treat all applications with strict confidentiality. Please send your application in English, marked “1920/Associated Project Director, COWI”, to job@besttalent.dk. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible due to the urgency of this position. For more information about Best Talent, please visit www.besttalent.dk.

Your new position

A central focus of the position is to enhance and grow relationships with analysts and investors in Europe. You will translate complex science, clinical progress, and strategy into a clear and credible narrative for shareholders, prospective investors, analysts, and the broader financial community. We offer exciting responsibilities:

Founded in 1998, Zealand Pharma is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with a U.S. presence in Boston, Massachusetts. Learn more at www.zealandpharma.com.

Do you want to build the operational backbone behind a new way of monetizing software - where pricing, product usage, data, and billing all need to connect seamlessly?

Trackunit is changing how we charge customers as we move from a traditional SaaS model towards more flexible, usage-based offerings. That means we need to connect a lot of moving parts: what customers use, how that usage is measured, what they have agreed to pay for, and what ultimately appears on their invoice.

As our Senior Monetization Operations Manager, you’ll help us make that entire flow work. You’ll build the processes and checks that help us catch errors early, keep our systems aligned, and give both customers and colleagues confidence that our billing is accurate.

This is a senior individual contributor role with a lot of ownership, but no formal people-management responsibility. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Revenue & Billing and RevOps. Some of the foundations are still being built, so you won’t simply inherit a finished setup. You’ll have an important role in shaping how we work—and we hope that’s the kind of challenge you find energizing.

Trackunit is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. We create digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry, helping one of the world’s least digitalized industries become more connected, efficient, and productive.

With locations in Denmark, Germany and the Netherlands, we offer a flexible setup giving you the option to work from our hubs or remotely in these countries.

**What’s in it for you?

**

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and support them through training, coaching and mindfulness, alongside an open feedback culture that helps you identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by focusing on your impact on yourself, your team, and the organization.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us. We believe you know how you work best. Once you've decided what works for you, we'll make sure you have the IT equipment and support you need.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. This priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We assess candidates solely on their qualifications and merit.

**Who are you ideally?

**We’re looking for a hands-on monetization operations expert who combines strong systems and data fluency with the ability to create structure across a complex, cross-functional environment.

**Ideally, You Bring

**

• Experience running or improving usage-based monetization operations, consumption platforms, metering, rating, or another environment where customer usage needs to be captured and processed accurately.

• The ability to follow data through several systems, spot when something doesn’t add up, and work out where the problem started - not just fix the final output.

• Experience setting up and testing products, price plans, usage rules, or similar configurations before they are released.

• A practical approach to processes and controls. You know how to make an operation reliable without creating unnecessary complexity or slowing everyone down.

• The confidence to bring Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, and commercial teams together when an issue crosses several areas - and to keep the work moving until the underlying cause has been resolved.

• Comfort working closely with both technical and commercial colleagues. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be curious about how data and systems work and willing to get into the details.

• The judgment to spot risks, challenge unclear ownership, and set clear standards, even when you don’t formally manage the people involved.

• Experience with usage-metering or monetization platforms such as m3ter, Metronome, Amberflo, or similar would be a strong advantage. Familiarity with Salesforce, NetSuite, Databricks, or related systems would also be valuable, but we don’t expect you to know our exact technology stack from day one.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this opportunity and your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification, we'd still love to hear from you.

**Primary Responsibilities

****In this role, you will:

**

• Build and improve the way we run monetization operations, including clear processes, responsibilities, checks, and ways to escalate issues.

• Make sure new products and pricing plans are set up, tested, approved, and released correctly in m3ter and our connected systems.

• Keep track of whether the full flow from customer usage to invoice is working as expected and make risks or gaps visible early.

• Put the right checks in place to identify missing, incorrect, or unusual data before it affects customer billing.

• Work with Finance and Revenue & Billing to make sure the data and documentation needed for invoicing, reconciliation, and audits are ready and reliable.

• Help turn agreed business and pricing rules into system configurations and practical ways of working.

• Lead investigations when usage, system configuration, or billing numbers don’t look right, bringing the relevant teams together to find and fix the underlying cause.

• Work with Product, Engineering, and Data to improve how usage is captured, moved between systems, and monitored.

• Create and maintain useful dashboards, instructions, control records, and documentation so people know what is happening and what to do when something goes wrong.

• Look for recurring problems and manual work that can be simplified or automated as the business grows.

• Help the Monetization Operations Specialist prioritize the right work and provide guidance on more complex issues, while working together as peers in the Monetization team.

**Our hiring process

**Don't waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that's not in the cover letter.

• Initial Interview conversation through zoom with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other better.

• Virtual meet and greet with the hiring manager and someone from the team.

• Assignment-specific interview. You'll receive a case study to prepare in advance and present to colleagues you'll work closely with in the role.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're excited to welcome you to Trackunit!

Position: Solution Architect - Continuous Improvement – Managed Services

Department: Managed Services

**What is your goal?

**As the Solution Architect Lead for Managed Services, you will be responsible for shaping the long-term evolution of our customers' Microsoft business application landscape after go-live. Rather than focusing on project delivery, your role is centered on continuous improvement, platform optimization, strategic advisory and technology roadmap development for enterprise customers running Dynamics 365 and the broader Microsoft ecosystem.

**Leading Microsoft Partner

**HSO belongs to the elite Microsoft Dynamics Inner Circle for 21 years, within the top 1% of all Microsoft partners worldwide. With over 2,800 professionals, and a worldwide presence, we deliver successful implementations across industries globally.

**HSO International

**At HSO International, you’ll join a diverse team of 350+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities, working on cross-border projects that make a global impact.

Learn more about Life at HSO International: https://www.hso.com/en/campaigns/life-at-hso-international/

**Key Responsibilities

**You will work closely with customer stakeholders and HSO delivery teams to drive health assessments, roadmap alignment, release readiness, architecture reviews, and strategic improvement initiatives that maximize long-term business value. This role is best suited for an individual with a proven track record as a Lead Solution Architect on complex, international Dynamics 365 programs and enterprise transformations.

**Requirements

****When do we match up?

****You have...

**

• 10+ years of experience working with Microsoft business applications, including Dynamics 365.

• Proven experience working as a Lead Solution Architect on large-scale international implementation projects.

• Strong expertise in enterprise architecture, solution governance, integrations and application lifecycle management.

• Experience engaging with business and executive stakeholders in global organizations.

• A track record of defining technology roadmaps and driving digital transformation initiatives.

• Experience leading architecture teams and providing technical leadership across complex delivery landscapes.

**You are...

**

• A strategic thinker who can connect business goals with technology decisions.

• Passionate about continuous improvement and long-term customer success.

• Comfortable challenging stakeholders and influencing strategic direction.

• Experienced in working across cultures and international teams.

• Fluent in English, both spoken and written; additional languages are a plus.

**Benefits

****Why should you choose HSO International?

****_Development and growth

_**You get a job with plenty of career opportunities with a leading provider of innovative enterprise business solutions and distinct Microsoft Global Solution Integrator, who perceives your motivations, talents and ambitions.

**_Fun and success

_**You work in a collaborative and professional environment where success is built on teamwork and with colleagues who are ready to help each other.

**_International project exposure

_**Joining our team offers an exciting opportunity to engage in international projects, providing invaluable exposure to diverse cultures, markets, and perspectives. Through your involvement in these projects, you will broaden your global network, enhance your cross-cultural communication skills, and gain firsthand experience in navigating the complexities of international collaboration.

**_Freedom and responsibility

_**You have the freedom and flexibility to organize your workdays, but especially to shape your own career.

**Take the next step!

**Does the combination of business processes and Microsoft technology appeal to you? Take the next step in your career path with HSO International!

**Your impact begins here

**As Product Owner, you will take full ownership of two global facility monitoring systems (FMS) that track environmental conditions (temperature, humidity, CO2, diff Pressure etc.) across Novo. The FMS supports product release and compliance, so they need clear direction and reliable delivery. You will bring that responsibility in-house, setting the strategy, priorities and budget that keep quality and supply moving.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are preferably already working as a Product Owner and are ready to take clear ownership of a product’s strategy, priorities, backlog and finances.

**You Will Also Bring

**

• An academic degree preferably in IT or business. Relevant experience counts as much as the path you took to get here.

• Around 3+ years of Product Owner experience, combined with broader relevant experience.

• Strong IT strategic understanding and experience shaping and owning the longer-term direction of a product.

• An understanding of technical and solution architecture at design level. You don’t need to be a deep technical specialist.

• Experience with cost management and budgeting.

• Strong written and spoken English. The team and stakeholder environment is fully international and works in English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Understanding of compliance in the pharmaceutical industry.

• Experience from production or manufacturing.

• Knowledge of facility monitoring systems, including the FMS solutions used at Novo.

• Experience with agile ways of working.

On a personal level, you bring the maturity to take ownership, make decisions and prioritise competing demands while staying effective under pressure. You are also able to lead informally and build strong stakeholder relationships across functions and cultures.

**What You’ll Do

**The two FMS solutions offer different functionality, so the right one can be chosen for each site and situation. Your job is to give both a clear direction and to make sure the product team delivers what matters most.

• Own the overall direction of both global FMS systems, setting the product strategy and longer-term roadmap.

• Own and prioritise the backlog, deciding what gets delivered and when, based on business needs and input from the product team.

• Lead the product team informally, aligning roles, responsibilities and deliverables so the team works effectively together.

• Manage costs, budgeting and the financial model, making sure costs are covered and following up on actual spend against budget.

• Manage stakeholders proactively. Spot potential issues early and bring the right people in before problems escalate.

• Act as the first escalation point when significant issues arise with the product or its implementations, and set a clear example on quality.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Monitoring and Control Solutions, the area that sets the strategic direction for global monitoring and control systems at Novo. The team is based at the Novo IT hub in Høje Taastrup, Denmark, and works closely online with stakeholders and the application vendor around the world. You can expect to spend much of your week in the office with your team.

Your closest colleagues will be your product team: a Product Manager, Business Analysts, Implementation Leads, a Compliance Partner, a Solution Architect and System Managers. Beyond the team, you will coordinate with Line of Business, implementation teams, lifecycle management, architecture and the application vendors. The systems serve factories and laboratories globally, so your priorities will affect sites across many countries and cultures. Your role is to bring these perspectives together, create clarity when things stall and keep work moving at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**This is a role with real ownership. You will be trusted to make decisions about two global systems, and your voice will shape where they go next. You will build broad experience across IT strategy, finance, architecture and manufacturing-related compliance, all in one product area.

You will work in a team that values a quality mindset, honest dialogue and an informal working climate, where colleagues support each other and never compromise on quality. Clear priorities and ambitious goals mean your results will be visible and recognised.

**What We Offer

**At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600 DKK to 1,091,600 DKK corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to take ownership of systems that help Novo release products with confidence, apply for the Product Owner role by 1st of November 2026.

• Knowledge of manufacturing, automotive or supply chain. Useful, but we can teach you the domain; we cannot teach you the craft, so do not rule yourself out on this.

**Language

**English is the only important language for this position; we work in English, and so do our customers. Danish language skills are not required.

Why this role is worth your time

• The scope is unusually large for the stage. You are one of a small number of engineers on a platform that serves demanding customers globally. What you build ships, and it ships soon.

• No layers between you and the decisions. You work directly with the co-founder and CEO, who runs product. There is no committee to navigate and nobody to translate your work for you.

• Hard problems that are not artificially hard. The complexity comes from the domain (hierarchies, state, audit trails, integrations that must not fail), not from organisational overhead.

• Real customers already, and real gaps. The product has paying customers in automotive and clear places where it needs to get better. Both halves of that are true, and both are why this is a good job.

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to team@supplios.com. Work examples will help.

jobs.occupation: Mid Level Backend Engineer - Financial Services
jobs.description:
💰🇩🇰 up to 48,000 DKK/month gross _(varies by seniority)

_**About Monta

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

The Role

We're looking for an Engineer to join our Financial Services team, the team responsible for every euro that flows through Monta's platform. This is a hands-on individual contributor role where you'll own delivery of meaningful pieces of our financial systems and grow your expertise in the domain, helping us scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes ownership of what they build. You'll own medium-sized projects from design through to production, working independently within your team and delivering quality outcomes.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. We use Claude Code extensively across the Financial Services team for everything from writing and reviewing code to designing systems and exploring financial domain problems. We expect you to be an advanced AI user who actively finds new ways to leverage these tools to move faster and think better.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Help rebuild Monta's financial backbone. You'll contribute to the new invoicing system that every customer will use, owning meaningful slices of the new infrastructure.

• Power EU expansion. You'll build features within our compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Deliver core parts of the new invoice system. Build features within the new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows, owning your slice end-to-end and contributing to design discussions.

• Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• Build for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll write code with auditability, correctness, and scale in mind, and contribute to design discussions for new components.

• Grow with the team. Contribute through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing, and help onboard new joiners as you grow into the domain.

What We’re Looking For

• Solid backend engineering experience. You've built and shipped production systems and you write clean, maintainable code. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• Some exposure to financial systems is a plus. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness matters — but we'll help you grow the depth.

• A sense of ownership. You take responsibility for what you ship, follow it through to production, and flag issues early rather than waiting to be asked.

• Comfortable asking questions and learning fast. Regulatory and financial domains have a lot of nuance — you bring curiosity and a willingness to dig in.

• Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

**Bonus

**

• Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing

**If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway. We care about potential, not perfection.

**AI at Monta Engineering

AI is central to how we build software at Monta. It's not a side experiment. It's embedded in our daily work and we expect every engineer to be a power user.

**Tools We Use Daily

**

• Claude Code for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code, exploring domain problems, and building internal tooling

• Claude / Gemini for research, design thinking, and documentation

• Notion AI for docs, knowledge management, and meeting notes

• AI-enhanced testing and monitoring

We expect you to bring a strong opinion on how to use AI effectively in engineering. If you've built custom workflows, pushed the limits of agentic coding, or found creative ways to use LLMs in your development process, you'll fit right in.

Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

jobs.occupation: Data Platform Engineer – Offshore Wind Industry
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building and running reliable, scalable and secure cloud data platforms? Do you want to work in the offshore wind industry, where your engineering skills will help secure a sustainable future based on renewable energy? Then keep reading: Cadeler is looking for a Data Platform Engineer with your skills and interests!

Cadeler is a global partner in the offshore wind industry, specializing in wind farm construction and maintenance. Our industry is more relevant than ever and plays a critical role in the energy transition, with a strong long-term outlook. As our industry continues to develop, so do we!

We are now looking for a Data Platform Engineer to help build, automate and operate our cloud data platform, ensuring that trusted and well-governed data is available for analytics, reporting and operational decision-making.

**What will you do?

**As our Data Platform Engineer, you will design, build and operate the technical foundations of Cadeler's data platform on Snowflake and Azure. You will work with business teams, application owners, IT and information security to integrate source systems, automate data pipelines and make reliable data available for analytics and reporting.

**Your Main Tasks Include

**

• Design, build and maintain data pipelines from various source systems, using managed ingestion tools such as Fivetran and custom Python where connectors fall short

• Orchestrate and schedule pipelines, handle dependencies, retries and backfills, and manage Snowflake warehouse sizing and compute cost

• Own CI/CD and source control in Azure DevOps: branching strategy, PR reviews, automated deployments and environment promotion (dev, test, prod), with database objects and infrastructure managed as code

• Design and implement dimensional data models (facts, dimensions, star schemas, slowly changing dimensions) across raw, staging, integration and mart layers

• Set up pipeline monitoring, anomaly detection and alerting, and troubleshoot and resolve incidents in production

• Deliver curated, performant datasets and semantic-ready measures so departments can build reports in Power BI

**To Succeed In This Role

**Being part of the Cadeler community means having a natural interest in and care for the environment, and in our shared mission to speed up the green energy transition. Environmental considerations and the safety of our people and the planet will be a key priority in your daily work.

We are looking for an innovator with a solution-oriented mind, who thrives in a fast-paced environment with many different interfaces.

We think you will be a good match if you have:

• A university degree in a relevant area such as computing, statistics or mathematics

• 3+ years of hands-on experience as a data engineer or data platform engineer

• Proven experience designing, building and operating production data pipelines

• Advanced SQL skills and strong Python skills for data processing, automation and tooling, and experience with dimensional modelling

• Hands-on experience with Snowflake (warehouses, RBAC, storage and compute management, cost control) and the Azure ecosystem

• An understanding of data security, governance and access control principles, as well as ability to define and write logic that transforms raw data into useful, interpretable, business-driven datasets

• Fluent spoken and written English

**Come work with us!

**By becoming a Cadeler employee, you will be part of a rapidly growing company with a diverse and energetic team. We offer an exciting position focused on delivering excellence in the face of interesting new challenges, within a positive and rewarding work environment in an international company with great development possibilities.

Cadeler is headquartered in Copenhagen, with offices in Vejle, Norwich, Rotterdam and Taipei, as well as colleagues working offshore aboard our fleet of Wind Farm Installation Vessels (WFIV).

Meet some of our colleagues here: https://www.cadeler.com/career

**Apply

**Use the APPLY button to apply for this position. For data protection purposes, applications are only accepted via the link and are assessed continuously until we find the right candidate, so please don't hesitate to send in your application as soon as possible and no later than the 6th of November.

If you have any questions about the position, and/or for practical matters, please contact peopleandculture@cadeler.com.

****Driven by a passion for business growth...

• dedicated to customer success...

• guided by an analytical, professional mindset...

• empowered by a collaborative spirit!

If you are motivated by these challenges, we invite you to become a vital member of our global Standard Parts team in Copenhagen. As our market expands significantly, you will have a unique chance to shape our strategic focus and champion the continued growth of Satair’s Standard Parts portfolio!

****At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

****At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Employee Health and Wellbeing: On-site gym, App-based health & wellbeing platform, Amazing canteen at a subsided price, Massage scheme

Learning and Development: Airbus Leadership University, Large number of e-learning and training offers for personal and professional development, Promotion of professional development (e.g. postgraduate studies, technician training), Possibility of mentoring, Gain international experience

Work-life blend and life phase support: Possibility to work remotely, 4 care days, Senior days, Working from home policy (2 days remote per week)

Board Intelligence is a technology and advisory firm on a mission to make boards more effective, and through them, build better businesses and benefit society.

Over twenty years we have established ourselves as the market leader in governance and board effectiveness, trusted by more than 80,000 directors, executives, and governance professionals globally, including across the Fortune 500, FTSE 100, and OMX 30. That trust has been earned through depth of insight, rigorous advisory work, and a track record that newer entrants simply cannot replicate.

We have invested in applied AI since 2020, well ahead of the market, and that early conviction has paid off. Our AI-powered platform and smart board advisor give us a competitive advantage that is widening, not narrowing. In 2024, K1 Investment Management, the leading B2B Enterprise SaaS investor, backed us to accelerate that position further. We are now growing fast, with a proven commercial model spanning both mid-market and enterprise, and a product suite that has become a necessary addition in high-stakes board environments.

The people joining us now will shape how we scale. We are deliberate about how we do that. Our founders and leadership team are deeply invested in keeping the culture that got us here: thoughtful, high calibre, and genuinely human. Ambition and balance are not in competition at Board Intelligence.

If you want to work at the intersection of AI and governance, on problems that matter at the highest level, this is a strong place to be.

Our Mission

We unleash the potential of organisations through the science of board effectiveness, building better businesses and benefitting society.

**The Role

**Juristic is a Danish legal tech company, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Copenhagen. Our platform brings four tools together on the same case data: Structure, Timeline, Flow and JuristIQ, our legal AI in chat and tabular formats.

Clients include PwC, Bird & Bird and Bech-Bruun. Juristic is now part of Board Intelligence, and we are bringing a new product to market. The work is led by our CTO, and we are looking for an AI Engineer to build it with them from the first line of code.

This is a zero-to-one role in a small team of four full-stack developers, a machine learning engineer and the CTO. You will write the code, sit in front of customers, and help decide what we build next.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and ship the AI capabilities at the core of a new product, from first prototype to production

• Own LLM-powered workflows end to end, such as document understanding, data extraction and agentic assistants

• Choose and integrate models and providers, and own the prompting, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails that make AI output reliable enough for legal and governance work

• Work directly with customers and the CTO to turn real problems into product decisions, and help own the product roadmap

• Lay the engineering foundations for the new product, including architecture, testing, observability and deployment, so it can scale

• Work with the wider Juristic and Board Intelligence engineering teams, and contribute to AI tooling shared across the suite

**Person Specification

**We are looking for a builder: an experienced AI engineer who has been a technical founder or an early employee at a startup, and who is ready to do it again.

Required Skills and Experience:

• At least four years of professional software engineering experience

• Experience as a technical founder or early employee at a startup, having built a product from the first line of code

• A track record of building and shipping AI or LLM-powered products to real users

• Practical experience with LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval and evaluating model output in production

• Strong engineering fundamentals across backend and frontend, with the judgement to move fast without leaving a mess behind

• A strong product mindset: you have worked directly with customers and owned a product roadmap

• Hungry, motivated and ready for another zero-to-one journey

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to haves:

Experience with our stack: TypeScript (Node.js and React) and Python

Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing and extraction from unstructured text

Experience building agentic systems, tool use or MCP integrations

Experience with search and retrieval infrastructure, such as Elasticsearch or vector databases

A background in legal tech, governance or B2B SaaS for professional users

What good looks like in this role:

• After three months: you know our customers, the product vision and the codebase, and you have shipped AI features that real users rely on

• After six months: the core AI capabilities of the new product are in production, backed by evaluations that show they are reliable, and you are acting on customer feedback

• After twelve months: the product is in market with paying customers, you are a trusted voice on the roadmap, and the AI foundations you built are reused across the Juristic and Board Intelligence suite

**Our Values

**Our values aren’t just words on a wall. They capture our culture, and the behaviours we see and strive for every day.

• Kindness & caring — We celebrate brilliance that comes without big egos or sharp elbows, and we win while raising each other up.

• Curiosity & innovation — Entrepreneurship is in our blood. We’re inquisitive, challenge convention, think big, and move fast.

• Remarkable quality & service — We take joy from delighting our clients and pride ourselves on ensuring every interaction is exceptional.

**Diversity, equity and inclusion

**Board Intelligence is committed to building a team that reflects the breadth of experience, background and perspective needed to do this work well. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, religion, sexual orientation or any other protected characteristic.

If you need any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please let us know and we will accommodate them.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
